title: 🔥 Quick & Tasty Chicken Biryani in 45 Seconds!
description: Learn how to whip up a mouth‑watering chicken biryani fast—perfect for busy cooks and flavor lovers alike. Follow the steps, grab your apron, and let’s get cooking!
thumbnailPrompt: A vibrant plate of golden chicken biryani with steam rising, surrounded by colorful spices in a bright kitchen setting.

elements.title: Ready for the BEST Chicken Biryani?

elements.caption: Hey food lovers, ready to cook the best chicken biryani in minutes? Let’s go!

elements.title: Step 1: Marinate
elements.subtitle: Chicken + Spices = Magic
elements.caption: Marinade time! Mix chicken with yogurt, ginger‑garlic paste, turmeric, red chili powder, and a splash of lemon. Let it chill for 15 mins.

audio.text: Marinade time! Mix chicken with yogurt, ginger‑garlic paste, turmeric, red chili powder, and a splash of lemon. Let it chill for 15 mins.

elements.title: Step 2: Cook Rice
elements.subtitle: Perfectly Fluffy Basmati
elements.caption: Boil basmati with a pinch of salt and bay leaf. Drain and set aside.

audio.text: Boil basmati with a pinch of salt and bay leaf. Drain and set aside.

elements.title: Step 3: Fry Onions
elements.subtitle: Crispy Gold
elements.caption: Sauté sliced onions till golden. Add cumin, cardamom, and cloves for that aroma.

audio.text: Sauté sliced onions till golden. Add cumin, cardamom, and cloves for that aroma.

elements.title: Step 4: Layer & Steam
elements.subtitle: Biryani Magic
elements.caption: Layer marinated chicken, cooked rice, fried onions, fresh mint, and cilantro. Top with saffron milk and steam on low for 10 mins.

audio.text: Layer marinated chicken, cooked rice, fried onions, fresh mint, and cilantro. Top with saffron milk and steam on low for 10 mins.
Fluff up, garnish with fried onions and nuts. Serve hot—deliciousness guaranteed!
